description_en: Deletes references to resources from a workspace without deleting the underlying resources
description_zh: 删除工作空间对资源的引用，不会删除底层的资源
name: DeleteWorkspaceResource

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated and will be retired. Use the ResourceType field
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group. To obtain the name of the resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源分组名。如果获取资源分组名，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The deletion behavior. Valid values:
DetachAndDelete: Unbinds the resources from the workspace and deletes the resources. This is the default value.
Detach: Unbinds the resources from the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
删除行为，取值如下：

DetachAndDelete（默认值）：与工作空间解绑并删除资源（默认值）。
Detach：与工作空间解绑
parameters.name: option

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource types. Valid values:
ECS: general computing resources
Lingjun: Lingjun AI computing resources
ACS: ACS computing resources
FLINK: Flink resources
MaxCompute: MaxCompute resources. Only the Detach option is supported. The DetachAndDelete option is not supported.
SelfManagedAckPro: ACK Pro unified management cluster resources
SelfManagedAckLingjun: ACK Lingjun unified management cluster resources
SelfManagedASI: ASI unified management cluster resources (third-party cloud)
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

ECS：通用计算资源
Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
ACS：ACS计算资源
FLINK：Flink资源。
MaxCompute： MaxCompute资源，目前只支持Option为Detach，不支持DetachAndDelete
SelfManagedAckPro：AckPro统一管控集群资源
SelfManagedAckLingjun：AckLinjun统一管控集群资源 
SelfManagedASI：ASI统一管控集群资源（三方云）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of tags, separated by commas
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources, separated by commas. The GroupName of these resource IDs must be the same. GroupName and ResourceIds cannot be empty at the same time, but both can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
逗号分隔的多个资源ID，这多个资源ID的GroupName必须一致
GroupName与ResourceIds不能都为空，可以两项都不为空
parameters.name: resource_ids

ResourceIds.description_en: The list of affected resource IDs
